VERIFIED 2026-09-29 (COMANDO 16 follow-up, scripts/audit_tx_tn_and_pet_truncation.py): the TX<TN guard runs on tasmax/tasmin merged by (date, cell_lat, cell_lon) right after loading (K->C only, no other treatment), strict `<`, counted per cell then summed to the country/model/scenario totals already reported -- confirmed 0 TX<TN AND 0 TX==TN in all 60 combinations (so the TX==TN/truncated-PET distinguishability question is moot here: it never occurs on this dataset). tasmax/tasmin are float32 both on disk and as loaded (verified directly), so exact equality is not numerically implausible at that precision; re-ran with a tolerance check (|TX-TN| <= 1e-6, compared in float64) anyway per instruction -- also 0 across all 707,545,940 cell-days tested (all 5 models x 4 scenarios x 3 countries, every plant-catchment cell). docs/METHODS_SPEC.md §1.3 now states this. The 50,221 truncated-PET cell-days trace to 51 distinct India cells (9 at 25-30N, 41 at 30-35N); 855 of these (cell, hydro-plant) catchment-weight pairs belong to 144 of India's 393 hydro plants (37%). REVISED 2026-09-29: an earlier version of this entry claimed the truncation had a specific SPEI-bias direction (relative to the untreated negative PET value); withdrawn -- a negative Hargreaves PET is a formula artifact below T_mean < -17.8 degC, never a physically valid quantity, so there is no meaningful 'untreated' baseline to be biased relative to, and truncating to zero is a correction, not a bias-introducing treatment. The real limitation (L16, docs/LIMITATIONS.md, rewritten) is that Hargreaves-Samani/the water-balance-SPEI framework has no snow accumulation/melt process and so cannot represent a glacial-regime catchment's water balance at all, independent of the truncation choice; affects the same 51 cells / 144 India hydro plants (37% of the country's hydro fleet). No local elevation dataset was available, so altitude was checked indirectly via per-cell mean T_mean on the affected days: min -19.89 degC, median -19.15 degC, max -18.03 degC across all 51 cells -- none above the -17.8 degC formula threshold, confirming all 51 are genuinely extreme-cold cells, not an artifact of a few outlier days.
